title: Add causally constrained forecast failure-mode sidecar
objective: Implement the smallest read-only failure-mode classification sidecar/report over existing frozen forecasts and immutable outcomes, preserving HIT/MISS while distinguishing evaluable direction, magnitude, timing, sequence, state/phase and action-translation error dimensions only when those semantics were prospectively frozen.
primary_target: scripts/learning/directly related forecast failure taxonomy helper
allowed_change_scope: scripts/learning/directly related forecast failure taxonomy helper
research/framework_memory/directly related non-authoritative failure-analysis sidecar root or summary

evidence.summary: Existing maturation correctly produces immutable HIT/MISS/CENSORED outcomes from frozen target semantics.
Current calibration ledger retains HIT/MISS and return but not a unified causally constrained failure-mode taxonomy.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect matured outcomes and model calibration ledger and confirm eligible rows are mechanically scored but there is no unified sidecar distinguishing direction versus magnitude/timing/sequence errors while failing closed when those semantics were not frozen.

positive: A frozen directional target that moved in the forecast direction but failed required magnitude is classified separately from wrong-direction failure when immutable fields support the distinction.
Unavailable timing/sequence/state/action dimensions are emitted as NOT_EVALUABLE rather than guessed.
negative: A censored outcome cannot be classified as prediction failure merely because the target was not scored.
No timing, sequence, phase or action-translation result is reconstructed from hindsight prose when the original forecast did not freeze that semantic.
